freeze_instructions: Set margin_eur_per_day and sign access_declaration, then set status to FROZEN_<date> in one commit; see docs/PROTOCOL_POLISH_TEST_DRAFT.md
record_of_proposal: configs/polish_market_protocol.json (22 September 2026, as shown to the supervisor) is kept unchanged; this file carries the test plan
source: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, day-ahead prices 12.1.D (A44), EUR/MWh, published values at retrieval

fallback_test.use_if: any signer of access_declaration has looked at July-August 2026 Polish day-ahead prices
fallback_test.window_change: 2026-10-25: end moved from 2026-10-31 to 2026-10-24 so the live paper test can start with delivery day 2026-10-26; prices from 2026-10-25 on are read by the live test, 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-24 stay unread

battery: polish_market.BESS defaults: 1 MW, 2 MWh, 10-90 percent, start and end 50 percent, 0.95 and 0.95, 10 EUR/MWh wear, binary MILP
decision: One full daily schedule fixed before 12:00 on D-1; prices up to and including D-1 are known at that time
eligible_days: Test days with 96 market time units that pass polish_market.validate_day; every method is scored on the same days; excluded days are listed

forecast.primary: polish_forecast.lear, prices only, walk-forward from 2025-10-01, refit for every day on all earlier days, min_days 56
forecast.why_prices_only: Exogenous inputs gave +1.16 EUR/day with an interval containing zero, and earlier versions of the load forecast cannot be audited

controllers.treatment: PPO, the five checkpoints in treatment_checkpoints, deterministic action (Beta mean), observing the LEAR forecast only
controllers.comparator: polish_market.optimize_schedule on the same LEAR forecast
secondary: MILP on the 7-day mean profile (polish_forecast.profile, window 7)
threshold rule, 10 slots per side, on the LEAR forecast

treatment_choice: 2000-update arm, highest June validation mean (214.37 EUR/day against 210.01 for 1000 and 194.83 for 300). Chosen on June, which is what the validation month is for; no retraining after the freeze
primary_endpoint: Mean over eligible test days of (PPO daily profit averaged over the five checkpoints) minus (MILP daily profit), EUR/day, realized prices

inference.method: circular moving-block bootstrap over test days

secondary_endpoints: each checkpoint minus MILP with the same bootstrap
PPO (mean of the five checkpoints) against each secondary controller
multiplicity: One primary contrast; everything else is labelled exploratory

access_declaration.question: Have you looked at Polish day-ahead prices for July-August 2026 (any source) or at any result computed on them?

execution: scripts/polish_test_run.py: lock (hashes of this file, code commit, checkpoints and test data) then run once; both refuse to overwrite

development_reference.note: Validation values, not test results; the test can differ
